_readme: Per-country curation of the Gente row, read by tools/build-culture.mjs (npm run culture). include = Wikidata Q-ids that go first (they must be real people with citizenship or birth in the country); exclude = never shown. The rule itself (buckets by domain and epoch) is in docs/PIPELINES.md.

MX.note: 2026-10-21: Rivera and Sor Juana sat just under the arts cut by sitelinks; Hidalgo is filed by Wikidata as a Spanish citizen (New Spain) and would never qualify as a native otherwise.
